map.清洁用品消耗量与补货周期适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Consumable Usage & Reorder Cycle best for?
map.追踪清洁用品库存与消耗速率，自动计算预计耗尽日期和补货周期，低库存自动预警并生成: Track cleaning-supply stock and consumption rate, automatically computing the projected run-out date and reorder cycle, with low-stock alerts and a generated shopping list.
map.📖 查看「清洁用品消耗量与补货周期使用指南」: 📖 View the "Consumable Usage & Reorder Cycle Guide"
map.日耗量 = 消耗速率 ÷ 周期天数（周=7 / 月=30）；可用天数 = ⌊库存: Daily usage = consumption rate ÷ days per period (week = 7 / month = 30); days available = ⌊stock ÷ daily usage⌋; reorder cycle = ⌊reorder threshold ÷ daily usage⌋
map.把「每周期消耗量」折算为日耗量后，用当前库存估算可用天数、用补货阈值估算应下单的: Once the per-period consumption is converted to a daily usage, the current stock estimates the days available and the reorder threshold estimates how often to order. Stock ≤ the reorder threshold is flagged "low stock", and days available ≤ 7 is flagged "about to run out".
map.暂无清洁用品，请先添加: No cleaning supplies yet; add one first
map.消耗速率按每周或每月统计，工具会自动换算为日均消耗来计算预计耗尽日期: The consumption rate is given per week or per month, and the tool converts it to a daily average to compute the projected run-out date
map.记录消耗时会自动扣减库存，也可手动调整库存（+1/-1/设置）: Logging consumption deducts stock automatically; you can also adjust stock manually (+1 / -1 / set)
map.补货阈值低于该值时自动预警，建议阈值设为正常用量的 1-2 周消耗量: A low-stock alert fires when stock falls below the threshold; set it to about 1-2 weeks of normal usage
map.购物清单建议购买量为阈值的 2 倍减去当前库存，确保补货后有充足缓冲: The suggested order quantity is twice the threshold minus current stock, to leave a comfortable buffer after restocking
map.登记洗洁精、纸巾、垃圾袋等耗材的单位、库存、消耗速率与补货阈值，自动推算还能用多: Register the unit, stock, consumption rate and reorder threshold of consumables such as dish soap, tissues and trash bags to work out how long they will last and when to order.
map.家庭或办公室盘点耗材时，把临近补货阈值的用品一次性列出来，集中采购。: When taking inventory at home or the office, list the supplies nearing their reorder threshold all at once for a single purchase run.
map.根据实际消耗修正速率参数，让补货提醒更贴合真实使用节奏。: Correct the rate parameters based on actual consumption so the reorder reminders better match your real usage rhythm.
map.纸巾还能用多久: How long will the tissues last
map.库存 12 卷、消耗速率 6 卷/月、补货阈值 4 卷：日耗量 = 6÷30 =: Stock 12 rolls, consumption rate 6 rolls/month, reorder threshold 4 rolls: daily usage = 6 ÷ 30 = 0.2 rolls/day, days available = ⌊12 ÷ 0.2⌋ = 60 days, reorder cycle = ⌊4 ÷ 0.2⌋ = 20 days; that is, stock hits the threshold in about 20 days, when an order should be placed.
map.某用品按「周」设置速率 3 件、库存 10 件：日耗量 = 3÷7 ≈ 0.43: A supply with a rate of 3 units per week and stock of 10: daily usage = 3 ÷ 7 ≈ 0.43 units/day, lasting about 23 days; if the same supply were wrongly set to 3 units per month, the days available would come out at about 100, so the wrong period greatly overestimates the time available.
map.保存在浏览器本地存储，不会上传服务器；清除浏览器数据会一并清除，重要清单建议另行: In local browser storage, never uploaded to a server; clearing browser data clears it too, so back up important lists separately.
map.消耗速率填不准怎么办？: What if I cannot set the consumption rate accurately?
map.可先用一段时间的实际消耗反推：速率 = 期间消耗量 ÷ 期间天数 × 周期天数，: Work backwards from the actual consumption over a period first: rate = consumption in the period ÷ days in the period × days per cycle, then fill it in and calibrate gradually.
map.阈值决定提前多久提醒，通常预留一次采购到货周期即可，例如补货需 3 天则阈值约为: The threshold sets how early you are reminded; a single procurement lead time is usually enough — for example, if restocking takes 3 days, set the threshold to about 3 days of consumption.
map.清洁用品库存与补货管理工具。添加清洁用品并记录当前库存、消耗速率和补货阈值，自动: A cleaning-supply stock and reorder tool. Add a supply with its current stock, consumption rate and reorder threshold to compute the projected run-out date and reorder cycle, with automatic low-stock alerts, a copyable shopping list, and consumption logging that deducts stock automatically, helping households manage cleaning consumables sensibly.
